BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to private cemeteries; and amending RCW 68.20.010,68.20.020, and 68.20.050.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 68.20.010 and 1943 c 247 s 42 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: It is unlawful for any corporation, copartnership, firm, trust,association, or individual to engage in or transact any of thebusinesses of a cemetery within this state except by means of acorporation or a limited liability company duly organized for thatpurpose.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 68.20.020 and 1983 c 3 s 167 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Any private corporation authorized by its articles or limitedliability company authorized by its certificate of formation so todo((,)) may establish, maintain, manage, improve, or operate acemetery, and conduct any or all of the businesses of a cemetery,either for or without profit to its members or stockholders. Anonprofit cemetery corporation may be organized in the manner provided p. 1 HB 2740in chapter 24.03 RCW. A profit corporation may be organized in themanner provided in the general corporation laws of the state ofWashington or in the manner provided in chapter 25.15 RCW.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 68.20.050 and 1943 c 247 s 59 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Unless otherwise limited by the law under which created(([,])),cemetery authorities shall in the conduct of their business have thesame powers granted by law to corporations and limited liabilitycompanies in general, including the right to contract such pecuniaryobligations within the limitation of general law as may be required,and may secure them by mortgage, deed of trust, or otherwise upon theirproperty.
